column1: # A DEATH THE TREE RECORDS WITH A PLACE AND NO DATE, CONFIRMED BY THE FAMILY (26 October 2026).
# Applied by tools/gedcom.py (apply_overlays): the source and grade are written on the person's death event and printed
# there. NO DATE IS INVENTED: the death stays undated. A confirmed death is a RECORDED death for the kit's living rule
# (a bare flag never frees anybody born in the window; a recorded, sourced death does). Refused for a person with a dated death.
# Replaces the hold in data/living-hold.tsv (take the hold out in the same commit).
# A FOURTH COLUMN, A YEAR (5 November 2026), is for a person the tree records with NO death and NO burial at all, whom the
# family says died that year and no more: a death event is ADDED with that year only (no day, month, place or cause), the
# source and the grade printed on it. Refused if the person already has a death or burial event (use three columns), if the
# year is not four digits, is after this year or before the person's birth year, or if the source or the grade is empty.
